name: Residential Neighbourhood
description: Intimate. Nature has grown through the houses. Personal devices, family hard drives, photo albums.

street_entrance.name: Overgrown Street
street_entrance.description: The road is cracked and lifted by tree roots. Houses on both sides, windows dark.

house_red_door.name: House with the Red Door
house_red_door.description: The paint is almost gone, but you can still tell it was red. Someone loved that door.

artifacts.description: A sealed personal device in a drawer.

house_red_door_upstairs.name: Upstairs Bedroom
house_red_door_upstairs.description: A child's room. Drawings still on the wall, colours faded to pastels.

hazards.description: The floorboards flex under your weight.

artifacts.description: A hand-drawn picture. Stick figures, a house, a dog. The sun is enormous.

house_corner.name: Corner House
house_corner.description: Larger than the others. A professional lived here — the study is still recognizable.

artifacts.description: A USB drive in a desk organizer, still sealed in plastic.

house_corner_basement.name: Sealed Basement
house_corner_basement.description: Dry. Deliberately sealed. Someone prepared this.

artifacts.description: A fire-rated cabinet, closed but not locked.
artifacts.field_note: Optical. Someone knew what they were doing.

community_garden_remnant.name: Old Community Garden
community_garden_remnant.description: The raised beds are still there, swallowed by wild growth. Someone's name on a small plaque.

artifacts.description: A metal plaque: 'Dedicated to J.M. She fed us.'
